description: Free discovery of x402 pay-per-call endpoints from 402xAgent's weekly crawl. Returns up to 20 endpoints matching the words in q (URL or source list), each with the verified (quoted) price, network, last_checked, stale flag, verdict pay|skip|recheck with its reason, and a receipt. Skips are included by default; pass verdict to filter. A result older than 36 h is stale; a pay older than 7 days is returned as recheck. Run endpoint_spot_check right before paying. Read-only, no auth, 60 calls per minute.

q.description: Optional. 2-100 chars; space-separated words that must all appear, e.g. "weather" or "crypto price".

name: discover
